name: Kurs povyshenija kvalifikacii
source:
Three female friends met at a refresher course for young teachers. And now, for the next week, the friends remembered the past and their little company. They all went to college together, graduated at the same time, but after college they separated and lost touch with each other for a while. And so, by chance, they meet again. But they will not only study in their free time, will they? Of course not! There are many more temptations in life...

[From [url=https://ajavrickstories.itch.io/advanced-training-course]itch.io[/url]]
